text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe's condition isn't improving, but fall arrives, and we manage to push through the worst of it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her weight has increased significantly, which gives her a sense of fulfilment. Agnes Tachyon also interprets this as a sign of growth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hopeful that our progress will continue, we decide to take on the St. Lite Kinen.
